plans.idea: Keep the original's left-to-right order: brand seal at the far left, the headline and subline as the main block, the bottle as a pause, then the orange Shop Now pill at the far right, so it reads brand, message, product, action.

Lead with the product: the bottle sits full height at the left, a wide text block follows, then the CTA, and the seal closes the row at the right like a sign-off, so the logo gets a real slot instead of being squeezed under the subline.

Lead with the headline: copy starts at the left edge for the biggest headline size, and the bottle, the seal and the CTA follow as a tight cluster on the right, so the product and brand sit next to the action.
